title: WPMS/2095/2015 of Pani Ram Vs Smt. Saraswati Devi

paras.text:
WPMS No. 2095 of 2015
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Mr. T.A. Khan, Senior Advocate
assisted by Mr. S.C. Dumka,
Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Amish Tiwari, Advocate for
the respondent.
Sri Pani Ram, petitioner is
present in person before this Court.
On the instruction of Sri Pani
Ram, petitioner, Mr. T.A. Khan,
learned senior counsel assisted by
Mr. S.C. Dumka, learned counsel for
the petitioner, submits that
reasonable time may be granted to
the petitioner to vacate the suit
property and to hand over peaceful
vacant possession thereof to the
landlord.
With the consent of learned
counsel appearing for the parties,
present petition, thus, stands
disposed of in the following terms:
1. Tenant/petitioner, herein,
shall vacate and hand over peaceful
vacant and actual physical
possession of the suit property to the
landlord on or before 31.12.2017;
2. Tenant/petitioner, herein,
shall pay to the landlord or
alternatively shall deposit with the
Trial Court entire arrears of rent on
or before 10.09.2015, after adjusting
amount already paid or deposited;
3. Tenant/petitioner, herein,
shall pay mesne profit @ Rs. 11/- per
day till actual physical possession of
the suit property is handed over to

the landlord with effect from
01.11.2014;
4. Entire arrears of mesne
profit shall also be paid to the
landlord or alternatively shall be
deposited with the Trial Court on or
before 10.09.2015;
5. Advance monthly mesne
profit shall be deposited with the Trial
Court on or before 10th day of each
and every month.
 6. Tenant/petitioner, herein,
shall file undertaking in the shape of
his own affidavit in the above terms
before the Trial Court on or before
10.09.2015.
7. If undertaking is not
furnished in the shape of affidavit or
arrears of rent and mesne profit is
not paid or deposited till 10.09.2015
or default is made in the payment of
monthly mesne profit, landlord shall
be at liberty to evict/dispossess the
tenant/petitioner, herein, from the
suit property with the help of police
force.
CLMA No. 9774 of 2015 also
stands disposed of accordingly.
 (Alok Singh, J.)
 26.08.2015
Deepak/JM
